output.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
output.explanation: Gross margin % per category is sum(net_amount - cogs) / sum(net_amount), taken over the lines of completed orders placed in 2025. Shipping fees are excluded.
